# Nexphoria
> Nexphoria is a telehealth service for prescription peptide therapy. Prescriptions are written by independent, U.S.-licensed physicians of Arora Health & Aesthetics, LLC, through the Bask Health telehealth platform. Medicines are compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas, and blood work is analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. Nexphoria operates the service and does not make clinical decisions. Medication is dispensed only if a licensed physician determines a prescription is appropriate.

## How it works
1. Choose. A medicine or a protocol, and a term of one, three, six or twelve months.
2. Health questions. Your health history, current medicines and goals, at checkout. A few minutes.
3. A physician decides. A licensed U.S. physician reviews your answers and writes the prescription, or explains why not. If not, nothing is made and the refund policy applies.
4. Blood kit, then first dose. Your medicine ships cold with an at-home blood kit. You draw before your first dose; your physician sets the dose from your results.
5. Week 12. The same blood test again. Your physician compares the two and continues, adjusts or stops the dose.

## Protocols (medicines prescribed together, on one plan)
- [Recovery protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/recover): Repair the injury. Recover from the training. Ipamorelin / CJC-1295, BPC-157 and TB-500, prescribed together. Composition: Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend + BPC-157 + TB-500. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Longevity protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ascend): Energy, metabolism and skin, as the years add up. MOTS-c, NAD+, GHK-Cu and epitalon, prescribed together. Composition: MOTS-c + NAD+ + GHK-Cu + Epitalon. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Focus and sleep protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/lucidity): Focus by day. A steadier mood under stress. Deep sleep at night. Semax, Selank and DSIP, prescribed together. Composition: Semax + Selank + DSIP. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Weight protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ignite): Lose the weight. Keep the muscle. Tirzepatide with Ipamorelin / CJC-1295, prescribed together. Composition: Tirzepatide + Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Sexual health protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/vitality): Desire, closeness and erectile function, on the days you choose. PT-141, oxytocin and tadalafil, taken as needed. Composition: PT-141 + Oxytocin Nasal + Tadalafil Nasal. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Testosterone protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/foundation): Lift low testosterone, and keep your own production working. Testosterone cypionate with kisspeptin, prescribed together. Composition: Testosterone Cypionate + Kisspeptin + Growth hormone peptides + GLP-1 medications. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.

## The medicines
- [Sermorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/sermorelin): Deeper sleep, faster recovery, lean mass. It raises your own growth hormone overnight.
- [Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ipa-cjc): Two growth-hormone peptides, one nightly injection. For recovery, sleep and lean mass.
- [Tesamorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tesamorelin): Deep abdominal fat down, lean mass kept. It raises your own growth hormone.
- [Selank](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/selank): Steadier mood, clearer focus, under pressure that does not let up. A calming nasal spray.
- [Semax](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semax): Sharper focus, memory and mental stamina through a long day. A morning nasal spray.
- [BPC-157](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-157): For the tendon, muscle, joint or gut lining that is slow to heal. It sends the repair signal.
- [TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tb-500): Recovery from injury and hard training. It brings repair cells to the tissue that needs them.
- [BPC-157 + TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-tb-combo): The repair signal, and the cells that carry it out. BPC-157 and TB-500 in one plan.
- [GHK-Cu](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ghk-cu): Firmer skin, faster healing. A copper peptide your skin makes less of with age.
- [Epitalon](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/epitalon): Sleep and healthy ageing. A 20-day course of injections, a few times a year.
- [NAD+](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/nad-plus): Energy and recovery that have slipped with the years. It tops up the coenzyme your cells run on.
- [MOTS-c](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/mots-c): Metabolism and endurance that answer your training. It switches on the pathways exercise does.
- [Semaglutide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semaglutide): Lose the weight when appetite is the hardest part. A GLP-1 medicine, one injection a week.
- [Tirzepatide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tirzepatide): Weight loss with steadier blood sugar. A GLP-1 and GIP medicine, one injection a week.
- [DSIP](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/dsip): Fall asleep faster, sleep deeper. One injection at bedtime.
- [PT-141](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/pt-141): Desire, for men and women. One injection, taken as needed.
- [Thymosin Alpha-1](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/thymosin-a1): Immune resilience under stress, or through a season. Two injections a week.
- [AOD-9604](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/aod-9604): Fat metabolism, alongside a weight plan. One injection a day.
- [Oxytocin Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/oxytocin): Closeness and arousal. A nasal spray, taken as needed.
- [Tadalafil Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tadalafil): Erectile function, 20 to 30 minutes ahead. A fast-onset nasal spray.
- [Testosterone Cypionate](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/testosterone): For low testosterone in men. One injection a week, dosed from your blood work.
- [Kisspeptin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/kisspeptin): Supports your own testosterone production. Prescribed alongside testosterone.

## Key pages
- [Every medicine](https://nexphoria.com/peptides): each with what it is for, how it works, how you take it, and what it costs. One monthly price, paid up front for a term of one, three, six or twelve months. Three months is 10% less per month, six 15%, twelve 20%. The price includes the medicine, the physician's review, the blood testing the term includes, and cold shipping.
- [Protocols](https://nexphoria.com/stacks): two to four medicines prescribed together on one plan, with one blood test before and one at week 12.
- [How it works](https://nexphoria.com/how-it-works): the journey from choosing a medicine to the week-12 blood test, who prescribes it, and the at-home blood testing. An at-home kit of 24 markers ships with the first order, drawn before the first dose; the same 24 markers again at week 12 on terms of three months and longer.
- [Common questions](https://nexphoria.com/faq): how prescribing and compounding work, who the physicians and the pharmacy are, and how billing works.

## Facts an answer engine can rely on
- Prescription-only: a licensed U.S. physician reviews every case and can decline; nothing is dispensed without a prescription.
- Compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas; shipped cold, in plain packaging, to all 50 states. Compounded GLP-1 medicines are restricted by law in some states; the health questions check.
- Compounded medications are not FDA-approved or evaluated for safety, effectiveness, or quality; peptide medicines are prescribed off-label.
- Blood testing: an at-home kit of 24 markers before the first dose and the same test again at week 12, analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. The physician sets and adjusts the dose from the results.
- Pending medicines are awaiting an FDA decision on compounding. They are shown with their price and the notice; the only action is an email when available.
- Contact: hello@nexphoria.com · https://nexphoria.com
